beats.text: Okay, quick guess! Big wedding or small wedding: which one lasts longer?
Plot twist: big wins! But only if it's big in the right way.
In the same survey, the more guests came, the lower the divorce risk. Up to about two hundred people!
But the ring? Men who spent two to four thousand dollars had one point three times the divorce risk. Compared to five hundred to two thousand. And the honeymoon?
Couples who took one were less likely to divorce!
So spend less on the ring. And invite more people!

sources: Francis-Tan & Mialon (2015), "'A Diamond is Forever' and Other Fairy Tales: The Relationship between Wedding Expenses and Marriage Duration", Economic Inquiry (working paper 2014, Emory University). Online survey of ~3,000+ ever-married US adults (KSL: 3,370). Correlational (hazard of divorce).

Divorce hazard decreases steadily as wedding attendance rises up to ~200 guests, slight uptick above. Men: ring $2,000-4,000 -> 1.3x hazard vs $500-2,000. Couples who had a honeymoon: significantly lower hazard. Via Aleteia (2015), KSL (2014).
